text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: ...And now, the moment you've all been waiting for: the announcement.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And the one chosen as the Umamusume of the Year, the symbol of this Twinkle Series season, is—

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
The first ever selected from the sprint division!
Power and speed that leaves everyone in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: It's Taiki Shuttle-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our "first three years" together flew by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I looked back on those hearty, overwhelming...
and precious days—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdyyyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you awake?
You're awake! All right, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I haven't explained yet!
It's a special party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A surprise from me
to the Trainer who's taken such great care of me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make today a fun one, so let's start the show!
Repeat after me—let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She went all out as always, but since she took
the trouble to prepare a party for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had intended to accept the surprise graciously, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo!
This is the party venue, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In America, I had barbecues with my family
on a wide-open ranch!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "This was the only place where you could experience that exact same feeling too, Trainer-desu!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't vorry!
I already got ze okay, you see!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That bold grandiosity is so like Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Usually it's packed and bustling with races, but it's very quiet today since we've reserved the place, yes?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's so spacious, it makes me wanna shout!
Tamayaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, let the party begin! Leave grilling the meat to meee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ate a quantity of impeccably grilled meat
so massive that it bordered on unreasonable.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What? Are you full already, desu ka?
There is dessert too, though...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Nothing we can do about it,
let's take a break from eating for now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that is right, yes!
Since we're at a racecourse, I'm going to go for a run, yes!
choice_data_list: What about permission to use the track!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it later, DESU! I'm an Umamusume,
so if there's a track, I just have to run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Taiki Shuttle really did
start running around the course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is truly lively,
boisterous, and overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was just like that during her races too;
every time she ran, she had me completely captivated."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Suddenly, I realize that
Taiki Shuttle has been gone for quite a while.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me you got hurt...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracing the track
in search of Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuugh... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day to thank Trainer-san...
So I thought crying was a big NO, BUT...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! I am so lonely, yes!
I cannot take this anymore, nooo!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My 'three years' with Trainer
have come to an end, NOOO~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I want to run together with you even more, Trainer! And have parties too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having reached the milestone of "the first three years,"
she seemed reluctant to say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, having achieved the title of "Umamusume of the Year,"
there was no reason for her and me to part ways here—
choice_data_list: We're still going to be together, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What does this mean? Why-yy?
Weren't we supposed to say goodbye after 3 years...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Taiki Shuttle that it was only
in the event she couldn't achieve a certain standard of results.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!! I jumped to conclusions!
Japanese is berry, berry difficult!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Which means I can keep running
together with you, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Very, very happy!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Let's keep on running together
forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll run even more for my family, for all my fans, and—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna make you happy too, Trainer-desu!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, thank you for everything so far!
And I look forward to working with you going forward-masu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will keep running alongside her.
With a run that will remain in the hearts of many!"
